description: Networks recorded with MMS ended at high confidence: the owner build never tests MMS there and says "MMS: not checked, the network no longer offers MMS" (round 26 rule change 6). Everywhere else MMS stays a test target, checked only by a silent MMSC reachability probe, never by sending an MMS.
source: OCD private repository, research/rule-decisions-20261006/mms-operator-ends-20261009.json (researched 2026-10-09), the rows with mms_status ended and confidence high
